description.en: Open and drive every dsh on your tailnet from any dsh, with a complete phone layout.
description.zh: 在任意 dsh 上打开并操控你 tailnet 里的所有 dsh，手机端界面也完整好用。

description.en: Split the DSH main area into up to four panes, each with its own tab strip, composer and view switcher. Drag a tab to a pane edge to split. Bilingual (zh/en).
description.zh: 把 DSH 主区换成多栏标签工作区：最多四栏会话并排，每栏自带标签条、输入框和宿主视图切换条。不能与 luckybilly 的 dsh-split-view 同时启用；安装的包名是 dsh-multipane。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: What the baoyu-design plugins share: the Artifacts page in the sidebar, and comments from their editors reaching the agent.
独立的宠爱桌宠插件：完整桌面宠物能力 + 宠爱页面。
DSH（DeepSeek Harness）娱乐工作台插件，集成音乐播放、小说阅读、漫画浏览、HTML5 小游戏和图片广场，支持阅读书源、洛雪音乐音源、漫画源及 RSS 订阅，提供统一资源管理、本地数据存储与 WebDAV 多设备同步。
2-4 real Chats you rearrange entirely from the keyboard, save as named layouts, and jump through by which pane needs you.
description.zh: 把 2 到 4 个真实对话并排放在一个窗口里，每个窗格都是完整聊天界面，方便对比和同时干活。

description.en: dsh Web UI admin plugin: nine management panels (extensions, MCP servers, commands, hooks, automation - cron / webhook / workflow, sessions & web search, usage dashboard, todo dock) inside the official dsh settings UI
DSH 插件：右侧栏常驻「余额明细」——DeepSeek 余额、赠送钱包，今日 token 消耗（含来源与每会话细分）、命中 / 未命中 / 输出、消费金额与 API 请求次数。
跨端互通：同一 DSH 账号下的会话、工作区、设备之间互通 —— 特征码链、内联邮件、云端中转站与自动备份
在 DSH 中打开本地 HTML 原型，点元素写批注，提交后把批注作为消息发给当前会话，由 Agent 修改源码。

Hash-anchored read/apply_patch/edit tools for DeepSeek Harness (dsh). Every line gets a unique 3- or 4-char hash (A-Za-z0-9, configurable) that stays stable across edits; apply_patch and the anchored range edit tool are the file-mutation entry points, eac
A workspace icon library for DeepSeek Harness: drag icons into the chat as <name>, let agents pick icons by meaning, and edit an SVG once to update every place it is used. 项目级图标库。
Desktop blue fish pet for DeepSeek Harness: per-pixel transparent WinForms window, text chat, and cloud speech-to-text voice conversation.
Delegation bridge for the dsh-realtime seam: answers what the voice model delegates, or says plainly that it cannot.
550C 皮肤：把 DeepSeek Harness 的整个界面换成 550C 控制台——四套磷光配色（琥珀/绿/青/白）、扫描线与暗角、等宽字体、机器读数栏，与 dsh-550c-boot 的开机片头同一套视觉。
在 DeepSeek Harness 中读取和继续 MonkeyAI 会话：查看完整对话历史、下发新指令，无缝接续之前在 MonkeyAI 客户端上的工作
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接翻看 MonkeyAI 设备的会话记录、续聊发指令，还能随时停止和切换模型。

description.en: Read-only install doctor: capability snapshot, tarball assert and install diagnosis.
description.zh: 只读安装体检工具，快照能力、校验压缩包并诊断安装问题，专治装不上、装不对。

description.en: dsh-invest-radar · 投资雷达 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）插件：A股投资者的全球产业链资讯看板。12 大赛道一一对应 A股板块，106 个海外权威 RSS 源本地抓取（去重 + 合规红线过滤），会话模型按 news-digest 技能提炼中文「今日要点」+ 标题翻译，侧栏「投资雷达」面板呈现。零 API key——提炼由 dsh 会话模型完成。
Archive the original context before DSH compaction replaces it with a summary — wraps the official summarize(), no engine changes.
Public/synthetic eval-pack lint and deterministic JSON grader; not a validated benchmark.
description.zh: 给公开或合成的评测集做格式检查，并用确定性 JSON 评分器打分，方便快速验证评测包。

description.en: DSH 网站运维工作台：一句话建站（自动配 nginx + 申请证书），装完能查多个站点的 SEO/GEO/安全，部署前看影响分析、出问题一键回滚。

Whole-disk, millisecond file search for DeepSeek Harness without Everything: a self-built cross-platform index, an Everything-style query language, agent tools and a Web search panel (Ctrl+Shift+F). Windows, macOS and Linux.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供自建跨平台索引的全盘文件名搜索，带 agent 工具和 Web 面板，不依赖 Everything。默认索引你的主目录；第一次内容搜索时还会在本机建全文索引（SQLite，放在系统缓存目录），范围是主目录下按扩展名认定的文本和源码文件（每个最大 1 MB、最多 20 万个）以及你最近的 DSH 会话消息；locator_export 会把索引的 SQLite 副本写到给定的任意绝对路径，overwrite 为 true 时会替换已有文件。引擎是随包提供的预编译 Go 程序（六个平台，源码在 engine/ 里），插件不发任何网络请求。

description.en: DSH 的轻量 QQ 机器人插件（零运行时依赖）：WebSocket 收群聊/私聊消息接入 dsh 会话，并提供 qq_message / qq_group / qq_bot 三个工具供 AI 主动调用（发消息、发文件、读消息、按需下载附件、群管理、查状态）。自带「设置 → QQ 机器人」页面，支持手机 QQ 扫码绑定，无需手抄凭据。

LLM-free deterministic context compaction for DeepSeek Harness. A drop-in replacement for @deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic that moves original tokens instead of summarizing them; anything cut stays recoverable verbatim through (seq N) pointers and recall
Meshy skills for DeepSeek Harness: textured, rigged and animated 3D models or print-ready files from text or images, through meshy-cli, with a Meshy settings page and a 3D preview for GLB files.
description.zh: 通过 shell 驱动 meshy-cli 的 Meshy 3D 生成与 3D 打印 Skill：文生 3D、图生 3D、贴图、重拓扑、绑骨与动画、格式转换，以及带可打印检查与修复的 3MF/STL 打印文件和切片软件交接。插件自带 CLI 并在宿主侧保持登录，在 Web 和 Desktop 中提供 Meshy 侧边栏页面、设置 → Meshy 页面和可交互的 GLB 预览；npm 包名 `meshy-dsh`。需要 Meshy 账号；生成会消耗 Meshy 点数，花费前先让你确认。

description.en: iasi 的 Agent skills 合集 DSH 插件：以 bundled skill 方式加载，免拷贝进 skills 目录。作者自用，不推广。
DeepSeek Harness 插件：按四部分流程创作 RP 卡，含世界书规则层、人工门禁、图像能力设置、上传卡评估与平台组装。
description.zh: 把一句话想法自动做成能直接导入平台开玩的 RP 卡，支持风月平台，分步人工验证。

description.en: DSH companion plugin for qq-bridge: chat memory archive/search/summary, web sticker sending and TTS voice messages over OneBot.
海底小队（Ocean Crew）：把 DSH Desktop 变成一支由长期存活的海洋伙伴 Bot 组成的团队：私聊、群聊、互相交付工作。
description.zh: 把 DSH Desktop 变成一支常驻的海洋伙伴 Bot 团队，能私聊、群聊、互相派活。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上「删除会话」：侧栏菜单一键删除，递归清理子会话、日志、投影缓存、搜索索引与工作区记账。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 补上删除会话功能，一键连子会话、日志和缓存一起清干净。

description.en: Local long-term memory core for DeepSeek Harness with plain-text notes, a bounded index, five tools, optional host-model consolidation and auditable evidence. It appends every user and assistant message under 32,000 characters to ~/.companion/cold/<date>.jsonl in plain text, with no built-in cleanup, and adds a short index of its notes to every system prompt; the optional model-based consolidation is off by default and, once on, sends those messages to the session's model.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地长期记忆内核：明文笔记、限长索引、五个工具、可选的宿主模型整理，并保留可追溯原话。它会把每条不超过 32,000 字符的用户和助手消息以明文追加到 ~/.companion/cold/<日期>.jsonl，没有内置清理，并在每次的系统提示词里加一份笔记索引；基于模型的整理默认关闭，打开后会把这些消息发给当前会话的模型。

description.en: Select text or tables in conversations to bookmark, highlight, and annotate in the right sidebar, with a collapsible all-sessions bookmark page.
description.zh: 在对话中选中文本或表格右键收藏并高亮，在右侧边栏内联添加注释，并提供按会话分组折叠的全局书签页。

description.en: A multi-tab AI chat panel for the desktop app: seven services (DeepSeek, 豆包, ChatGPT, MiniMax, Kimi, Gemini, Grok) each run in their own webview and login partition, and the chat can live in the left navigation panel or in a right sidebar tab — whichever one you open owns it. Desktop app only; logins last until the app restarts unless you apply the optional manual patch (tools/shell-patch) to the desktop app's resources/app.asar, and restore-shell-patch.cmd reverts it.
description.zh: 桌面版的多标签 AI 聊天面板：七个服务（DeepSeek、豆包、ChatGPT、MiniMax、Kimi、Gemini、Grok）各自在独立 webview 与独立登录分区中运行，聊天页可放在左栏主面板或右栏标签里——哪边点开就由哪边承载。仅限桌面版；登录态只在本次运行内有效，要跨重启保持需自行给桌面版的 resources/app.asar 打可选补丁（tools/shell-patch），restore-shell-patch.cmd 可还原。

description.en: Paragraph- and file-level search across the current conversation and all sessions, with a date/turn filter window and a jump that highlights the match. Defaults to the last 14 days and the latest 30 turns of each session; leave a limit empty to remove it.
description.zh: 按段落与文件名检索当前或全部会话，支持日期与轮次筛选，跳转后高亮命中词。默认只搜最近 14 天、每个会话最近 30 轮，清空某项限制即可不限。

description.en: Desktop BigFish companion for DeepSeek Harness with editable bubbles, action packs, market sentiment and a read-only dsh-meme gallery. Defaults: it checks your DeepSeek balance every minute with your API key (or the logged-in account) and shows it in the bubble; market sentiment is off until you enable it, and then polls Tencent and Eastmoney quote endpoints (Tushare too if you add a token). It installs from a release package of about 200 MB that bundles the desktop helper.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的桌面大肥鱼伙伴：可编辑气泡、动作包、行情情绪，以及只读的 dsh-meme 斗图图库。默认行为：每分钟用你的 DeepSeek API 密钥（或已登录的账户）查询一次余额并显示在气泡里；行情情绪默认关闭，开启后会轮询腾讯和东方财富的行情接口（填了 Tushare token 还会请求 Tushare）。它从约 200 MB 的发布包安装，里面带着桌面端助手程序。

description.en: Visualizes Finesse 3 KatScript in the conversation and adds a drag-and-drop optical bench designer that generates the Finesse model. It scans every user and assistant message for KatScript or a Finesse Python cell and renders them in the background with the first Python interpreter that can import finesse (Finesse 3, NumPy and Matplotlib required; interpreter overridable with FINESSE_VIZ_PYTHON), keeping the code and figures under ~/.dsh/finesse-vis.
description.zh: 在对话中自动把 Finesse 3 KatScript 渲染成光学构型图，并提供拖拽式光学设计器实时生成对应的 Finesse 模型。它会扫描每条用户和助手消息里的 KatScript 或 Finesse Python 单元，在后台用第一个能 import finesse 的 Python 解释器渲染（需要 Finesse 3、NumPy 和 Matplotlib，可用 FINESSE_VIZ_PYTHON 指定解释器），代码和图存在 ~/.dsh/finesse-vis。

description.en: One-click lock screen: a sidebar button covers the whole interface with the current Windows wallpaper, and two Esc presses unlock it.
description.zh: 一键锁屏：侧栏按钮用当前 Windows 桌面壁纸铺满并遮住整个界面，连按两次 Esc 解锁。

description.en: A market card pinned to the DSH sidebar: live price and 24-hour change for crypto pairs, A-share / Hong Kong / US stocks and world indices, FX majors and London spot gold and silver. An optional long or short cost basis plus a position size turn the change column into a P&L percentage and a cash amount; symbols, order and refresh interval are chosen in DSH settings. No login and no API key. Quotes come from public endpoints of Gate.io, Eastmoney and Sina, and the symbols you choose are sent to them on every refresh.
description.zh: 钉在 DSH 侧栏的行情卡片：加密货币、A股 / 港股 / 美股与世界主要指数、外汇直盘、伦敦金银的实时价格与 24 小时涨跌幅。填上买入或做空成本价与持仓数量后，涨跌列会切换成盈亏百分比与浮动金额；标的、顺序、刷新间隔都在 DSH 设置页里决定。免登录、免密钥。行情取自 Gate.io、东方财富和新浪的公开接口，每次刷新都会把你选的标的发给它们。

description.en: Switches which assistant persona answers, based on how the message addresses it (alias matching, with names inside quotes and copula phrases such as "is/was" excluded); each persona is a folder holding its own prompt, aliases, colour, avatar and optional lore, several personas can answer one turn, and a settings panel plus a per-turn routing log make each switch checkable. Personas live under ~/.dsh/personas (deleting one in the panel removes its folder) and the routing log in ~/.dsh/persona-router keeps the first 60 characters of each message; its HTTP routes (/persona-router/…) have no DSH access check.
description.zh: 按这句话怎么称呼助手来切换作答的人格（别名匹配，引号内的名字与「是 / 为」这类系词不算称呼）；每个人格是一个文件夹，装着自己的提示词、别名、配色、头像与可选世界书；一轮可以让多个人格同时作答；设置页有面板和逐轮判定日志，每次切换都可复查。人格存放在 ~/.dsh/personas（面板里删除人格会删掉它的文件夹），判定日志在 ~/.dsh/persona-router，会记下每条消息的前 60 个字符；插件的 HTTP 路由（/persona-router/…）没有 DSH 的访问检查。

description.en: Sorchron Study Board, a study workspace plugin with pomodoro timer, task management and activity heatmap for DSH harness. Records stay in the browser's localStorage (JSON export for backup) and the plugin makes no network requests.
description.zh: 溯时学习工作台，为DSH提供番茄计时、任务管理与学习热力图的学习工作台插件。记录只存在浏览器的 localStorage（可导出 JSON 备份），插件不发任何网络请求。

description.en: Daily session digest that grows a user profile and a companion personality, gated by evidence, and injects both into every prompt. Runs daily at 17:00 by default over up to 20 sessions per run on the host model (deepseek-v4-pro), applies the results automatically, and injects up to 1200 characters of profile and persona into every prompt. Its package name, dsh-persona-memory, is also used by other listed entries, so install only one of them.
description.zh: 每日会话摘要，按证据门槛生长用户画像与陪伴性格，并注入每次对话。默认每天 17:00 自动运行，每次最多处理 20 个会话，使用宿主模型 deepseek-v4-pro，结果自动应用，并把最多 1200 字的用户画像与性格注入每次对话。包名 dsh-persona-memory 与列表中其他条目相同，只能装其中一个。

description.en: Shows whether the DeepSeek API is currently billing at the peak or off-peak (half-price) rate in the conversation title bar, with a live countdown once the next switch is under 30 minutes away and the Chinese statutory-holiday calendar built in.
description.zh: 在会话标题栏显示 DeepSeek API 此刻按高峰还是半价计费；离下次切换不足 30 分钟时把倒计时直接显示在标签上，内置中国法定节假日表。

description.en: Manage iterative text annotation through DSH tools with rule versions, stale-result isolation, human review preservation and traceable exports; requires a separately installed Python backend.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 工具管理可迭代文本标注，绑定规则版本、隔离旧任务结果、保留人工审核并导出可追溯数据集；需另行安装 Python 后端。

description.en: Exposes the chat models of a locally signed-in QwenWork desktop app as a Harness provider, with a multi-account pool, session affinity and failover, pre-expiry credential renewal, a health watchdog, per-model enable/context-window/input-type settings, and account status with credit balance. Unofficial local integration that reuses your own signed-in client credential; your own account only. Windows only: needs the QwenWork desktop app signed in, and keeps its account pool in a DPAPI-protected file under %LOCALAPPDATA%. The author warns that reusing the client credential may conflict with the vendor's terms.
description.zh: 把本机已登录的千问办公（QwenWork）桌面端对话模型接入 Harness 模型列表：多账号池、会话粘性与故障切换、凭证到期前自动续签、看护式保活、按模型独立开关/上下文窗口/输入类型，并展示账号状态与积分余额。非官方本地集成，复用使用者本人已登录客户端凭证，仅限本人账号自用。仅支持 Windows：需要千问办公桌面端已登录，账号池保存在 %LOCALAPPDATA% 下由 DPAPI 保护的文件里。作者提醒，复用客户端凭证可能违反厂商的服务条款。

description.en: A manual screenshot button for the DeepSeek Harness composer that captures a screen region and sends it to the model as an image attachment. Windows only.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 输入框加一个手动截图按钮：框选屏幕区域后自动作为图片附件发给模型。仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Folds older oversized tool results into spill files and replaces them with short, deterministic stubs at step boundaries, with no LLM call: the stub keeps the first 200 and last 80 characters plus the sequence number, tool name, line/char/size counts and the original file path, and each fold is a real surface replacement accompanied by compaction/prune shadow pricing so token counts stay honest. Triggers on context pressure at 25% of the model window (falling back to 32768 tokens when the window cannot be resolved) or on five accumulated candidates; the last three turns, error results and rich content are never folded. The original is recovered from the session log rather than the spill file, so /folds, /unfold <seq> and /unfold all keep working after spill cleanup; session_fold_recall lets the model fetch a folded result by sequence number or by keyword, and session_fold_diagnose reports the effective settings. /spill-prune removes orphaned spill directories, preview only unless --apply. A Settings page exposes 12 of the 13 options as draft-then-save fields; they are volatile, so saved changes apply without restarting the plugin.
description.zh: 在 step 边界把较早的超长工具输出折叠为落盘原文加短替身，全程不调用模型：替身保留原文头 200 与尾 80 字符，并附序号、工具名、行数/字符/大小统计与原文路径；每次折叠都是真实的 surface 替换，并紧邻写入 compaction/prune 影子计价，token 统计不虚高。上下文估算达到模型窗口 25%（解析不出窗口时退回 32768 token）或候选积满 5 条即触发；最近 3 轮、错误结果与富内容永不折叠。原文从会话日志恢复而非 spill 文件，因此 spill 被清理后 /folds、/unfold <序号>、/unfold all 依然可用；session_fold_recall 供模型按序号取整条原文或按关键词检索，session_fold_diagnose 输出当前生效配置。/spill-prune 清理无主的 spill 目录，默认只预览，加 --apply 才删。设置页把 13 个配置项中的 12 个暴露为「先改草稿、再点保存」的字段，且为 volatile，保存后无需重启插件。

description.en: Per-task cost dashboard and budget guard that prices each model call at peak or off-peak rates, turns the remaining budget into a per-turn work envelope in the system prompt, and stops the task at its cap until the user replies. The default cap is ¥0.5 per task.
description.zh: 按任务统计模型调用费用（峰/谷价），把剩余预算换算成每轮提示词里的调用/文件额度，并在超出上限时暂停任务等待用户确认。默认每个任务的上限为 ¥0.5。

description.en: UML sequence diagrams as editable .drawio files from a JSON spec: Python places participants, fragments and labels, the draw.io desktop CLI renders a PNG at 1x-4x, and Pillow verifies the output size. Generation is deterministic and refuses to overwrite a file edited by hand. Needs Python with Pillow 12.x and the draw.io desktop app; the default paths are Windows ones (Python under C:\Program Files\Python314, draw.io under D:\drawio) and can be changed in the settings card.
description.zh: 用 JSON spec 生成可编辑的 UML 时序图 .drawio：Python 负责参与者、片段与标签布局，draw.io 桌面 CLI 按 1x-4x 渲染 PNG，Pillow 校验输出尺寸。生成结果确定可复现，遇到手工改过的文件会拒绝覆盖。需要 Python（含 Pillow 12.x）和 draw.io 桌面版；默认路径是 Windows 路径（Python 在 C:\Program Files\Python314、draw.io 在 D:\drawio），可在设置卡片里修改。

description.en: Adds budgets to agent waiting: caps job_output waits, refuses runaway foreground commands inside run_code, breaks status-polling loops after four no-progress probes, and explains run_code deadlines and parse errors.
description.zh: 给 agent 的等待加预算：限制 job_output 等待、拦截 run_code 里超长的前台命令、连续四次只查状态就熔断轮询，并解释 run_code 的截止时间与解析错误。

description.en: A Desktop 0.2.2-rc.1 adaptation of DSH WebTokens that registers a signed-in Chrome DeepSeek web session as the deepseek-web model in DeepSeek Harness, with tool-call transport, reply validation, a Chrome bridge extension, plus install and rollback scripts. It cannot be installed with the one-line plugin add shown on this page: it needs its own installer (node scripts/install-desktop.mjs, which backs up the whole profile first). Prompts, project content and tool results are sent to the DeepSeek website through your Chrome session; the author has tested it on macOS only.
description.zh: DSH WebTokens 的 Desktop 0.2.2-rc.1 适配版：把已登录的 Chrome DeepSeek 网页会话注册为 Harness 的 deepseek-web 模型，提供工具调用传输、回复校验、Chrome 桥接扩展，以及安装与回滚脚本。不能用本页显示的单条 plugin add 命令安装：它需要自己的安装脚本（node scripts/install-desktop.mjs，会先备份整个 profile）。提示词、项目内容和工具结果会经你的 Chrome 会话发往 DeepSeek 网页；作者只在 macOS 上测试过。

description.en: Windows 11 Mica, Acrylic and Tabbed backdrop materials for the DSH desktop window, with adjustable page opacity; a bundled app.asar patch makes the window transparent so the wallpaper shows through. Windows only. The transparency patch is a separate step you run yourself (node tools/window-bridge.mjs apply, with DSH closed): it edits the installed app.asar, keeps a backup next to it, and restore undoes it.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面窗口换上 Windows 11 的 Mica、Acrylic、Tabbed 系统材质，页面不透明度可调；随包附带的 app.asar 补丁让窗口透明，壁纸才会透出来。仅限 Windows。透明补丁是要你自己另外运行的一步（关闭 DSH 后执行 node tools/window-bridge.mjs apply）：它会修改已安装的 app.asar，并在旁边留一份备份，restore 可还原。

description.en: Sidebar playground for SenseNova and Agnes image and video generation, per-provider API keys and default models, local result management, and sgen_* tools for conversations. Each request runs the bundled sgen command-line tool, any reference image or audio you give by local path is uploaded to the provider as base64, API keys live in ~/.sgen/config.json, and the sidebar saves results under ~/sgen unless you pick another folder.
description.zh: 侧栏试验场调用商汤与 Agnes 生成图片和视频，按供应商设置 Key 与默认模型，管理本机生成结果，并向对话提供 sgen_* 工具。每次请求都会运行安装包里自带的 sgen 命令行；按本地路径给出的参考图和参考音频会以 base64 上传到服务商；API Key 存在 ~/.sgen/config.json；侧栏生成的结果默认存到 ~/sgen（可改目录）。
